# Black Wood Tea (blackwoodtea.onrender.com)

> blackwoodtea.onrender.com is an independent reader information site about Black Wood Tea, a herbal tea supplement. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's page and supplied photos)
- Form: herbal tea supplement in a pouch; the seller gives no amounts, servings or preparation steps
- Named ingredients: horny goat weed, ginseng, maca root, tongkat ali, ginkgo biloba, tribulus terrestris, catuaba bark, L-arginine
- The seller's benefits text also mentions yohimbe, rhodiola, bacopa and beetroot, which are not in its ingredient list
- Price stated by the seller: $49 a pouch (regular $99); 1, 3 and 6 pouch options; one-time payments; two bonus ebooks listed with 3 and 6 pouches
- Ships by UPS, processed within 24 hours, delivered in 5 to 7 business days (seller's statement)
- 60-day money-back guarantee; contact support by email
- Not a treatment for erectile dysfunction or any disease; L-arginine and horny goat weed can interact with nitrates, blood pressure medicine and erectile dysfunction drugs; ginkgo can add to blood thinners
